Calendar

Events, task dates, reminders and your Outlook, Teams or Google calendar.

#Views and moving around

Day, work week, week, month and agenda.

  1. Month scrolls continuously; Day, Work week and Week page sideways with a swipe.
  2. Keys: ← → previous / next, T today, D / W / M / 5 / A choose the view.

#Creating and changing events

Drag on the grid to create; drag to move; drag an edge to resize.

  1. Right-click a time → New event here (or New all-day event).
  2. Double-click an event to see its details; Edit changes it. Hold Alt (Option) while dragging to copy.
  3. Events can repeat, carry a link, people, notes and a Doceo note (Take notes creates a meeting page).

#Outlook, Teams, Google and iCloud

Subscribe to a calendar link, or sign in with Microsoft 365.

  1. Add calendar → Microsoft 365 / Teams to sign in (read only), or paste an ICS link (Outlook “Publish calendar”, Google secret iCal address, iCloud webcal).
  2. Feeds refresh automatically (and with Refresh now). Their events are read only; dragging one makes a local copy.
  3. Your responses (accept / tentative / decline) are saved in Doceo only — nothing is sent back.
